about: A free tool that converts word lists between Chinese input methods, such as Sogou, Google and Microsoft Pinyin.

prs.title: Sogou backup export keeps words with lüe and nüe
prs.broken: Exporting to the Sogou backup format silently dropped every word whose pinyin has lüe or nüe, such as common words for strategy and neglect, and reported them as filtered.
prs.changed: These syllables are now written the way Sogou's pinyin table spells them, so the words are found and kept.
prs.matters: People moving their word lists to Sogou keep all their common words.

prs.title: Batch export into a folder works from the command line
prs.broken: The batch mode from the README, exporting several word lists into a folder, always failed with an access error and wrote nothing.
prs.changed: When the output path is a folder, the command line now writes one file per input, as the desktop app already did.
prs.matters: The documented way to convert many word lists at once works.
